messages.subject: Residual calculated incorrectly?
parts:
Hi,
When I fit all the residuals (for an ExonRmaPlm model) from scratch, I
am getting incorrect calculations of the residuals for the odd unit (as
compared to my manual calculations). When have the residuals recalculate
for just that unit, however, I get the right value. When I recalculate
residuals for 1000 random units that include that unit, I also get the
right value.
Best,
Elizabeth
